summary: Feed s104_single is degraded: 17.8% of frames truncated (mostly to 256 bytes) breaks IDS full-payload inspection. All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLAN, one-way, oversize, drops, overload, tunnel) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker slicing/snap-length is set to ~256 bytes on this feed, cutting payloads short before delivery to the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection; truncated frames hide application payload and prevent reliable detection, causing missed alerts and incomplete stream reassembly.

recommended_fix.why: IDS requires full payload up to 1518 bytes per tool profile; disabling slicing restores complete frames for inspection. If bandwidth must be reduced, use filtering or load balancing instead of payload slicing.
